# Dart examples

Run the package's first-install steps before using an example. See the repository [example guide](https://github.com/jabdori/maxt/blob/main/docs/examples.md). Public reads run normally; credentialed reads require a read-enabled account; request-only examples do not submit financial writes.

## Run the first public read

From a repository or package checkout, run:

```text
dart run example/main.dart
```

| Task | Safety | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read public market data | public read | [main.dart](main.dart) |
| Read candles and paged history | public or credentialed read | [candles_history.dart](candles_history.dart) |
| Receive public and account streams | public read or credentialed read | [streams.dart](streams.dart) |
| Read balances, rules, and asset configuration | credentialed read | [account_and_safety.dart](account_and_safety.dart) |
| Inspect and validate order workflows safely | request only or credentialed read | [account_and_safety.dart](account_and_safety.dart) |
| Inspect transfers and wallet configuration | credentialed read or request only | [account_and_safety.dart](account_and_safety.dart) |
| Read funding, positions, and margin | public or credentialed read | [derivatives.dart](derivatives.dart) |
| Use Binance Spot, USD-M, and wallet APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [binance_provider.dart](binance_provider.dart) |
| Use Upbit region and provider-specific APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [upbit_provider.dart](upbit_provider.dart) |
| Use Bithumb market, KRW, and TWAP APIs | public, credentialed read, or request only | [bithumb_provider.dart](bithumb_provider.dart) |
| Use Hyperliquid market and address-scoped Info APIs | public or address-scoped read | [hyperliquid_provider.dart](hyperliquid_provider.dart) |
| Use public reads in a browser and route signed calls through a relay | browser boundary | [browser_relay.dart](browser_relay.dart) |
